p0.descriptionHtml:
A classic pattern, stitched in velvet. The Herringbone Channel Bed has a headboard with diagonal channels stitched to form a herringbone pattern.

Key features

  • Diagonal channel stitching in a herringbone pattern
  • Tall headboard
  • Fully upholstered base to the floor, no exposed legs
  • Rich velvet
  • Comes with a wooden slatted base

Materials and build

Built on a wooden frame and fully upholstered by hand in our West Yorkshire workshop, with no exposed legs. Made in the fabric and colour you choose. Free fabric swatches are available before you order.

Sizes available

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Standard Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT). Need a different size, headboard height or an ottoman storage base? Ask us about a bespoke version.

Mattress compatibility

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose.

Delivery

Free delivery to mainland UK addresses by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Let us know about stairs or tight access when you order.

Care

Vacuum gently with a soft brush attachment and blot any spills straight away with a clean, damp cloth.

Backed by our 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.

p5.descriptionHtml:
Watch in comfort, then make the screen disappear. The Kingston Ottoman TV Bed hides a television lift inside its padded footboard, so your TV rises when you want it and tucks away when you don't. Underneath, a gas-lift ottoman base gives you a full bed's worth of hidden storage.

Key features

  • TV lift built into the upholstered footboard
  • Gas-lift ottoman base with storage under the whole mattress
  • Tall vertical-channel headboard in plush velvet
  • Handmade to order in our West Yorkshire workshop

Materials and build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in plush velvet, in your choice of colour. Free fabric swatches are available before you order. Please contact us to confirm the TV sizes and fixings that suit this bed before ordering.

Sizes available

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Standard Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT).

Mattress compatibility

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. A mattress designed to sit well on a gas-lift base is recommended.

Delivery

Free delivery to mainland UK addresses by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Please tell us about stairs or tight access when you order.

Care

Vacuum the velvet gently with a soft brush attachment and blot spills straight away with a clean, damp cloth. Keep the TV lift area clear of bedding and objects.

Backed by our 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.
